hypothesis: Template sends with fake scarcity returned 0 replies in 37 sends (user's own test was the only reply). 2026 benchmarks (ReachIQ May-2026, Instantly Jan-2026): deep per-prospect personalization replies 9.6% vs 1.8% token personalization; emails under 80 words win. Hypothesis: operative-fact personalization + one specific question + zero scarcity lifts single-touch reply rate toward 10-30%.
